## Ingredients

- olive oil
- 2 lb ground beef
- 2 medium onions, minced
- 1 large carrot minced
- 2 large celery stalks minced
- 1.5 cups dry red wine
- 2 cups chicken or beef stock or water
- 2 cups milk (whatever)
- 2 bay leaves
- 1 inch by 3 inch strip of lemon zest
- 1 1 inch by 3 inch strip of orange zest
- 1/2 inch piece of cinnamon
- 5 tablespoons tomato paste
- 1 lb rigatoni
- salt, parmesan rind, whole nutmeg, black pepper, 4 tbspoons butter, grated parm
